questions.q: How many teams reach the quarter-finals of a World Cup?
Who scored Argentina's first goal in the famous 1986 QF vs England?
questions.explanation: Maradona scored both — the 'Hand of God' and the 'Goal of the Century'.

questions.q: Which African team first reached a World Cup quarter-final?
questions.explanation: Cameroon's run in Italia 90 broke new ground for African football.

questions.q: Which country has lost the most World Cup quarter-finals?
questions.explanation: Mexico has been eliminated at the round of 16 / QF stage many times — often referred to as the 'fifth game curse'.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot at the 2022 World Cup?
Which World Cup final had the highest combined score?
questions.explanation: Argentina 3-3 France in 2022 was the highest-scoring final in regulation+ET.

questions.q: Which player holds the record for most assists in a single World Cup?
questions.explanation: Pelé recorded the most assists in a single World Cup (1970).

questions.q: Which trophy is presented to the World Cup winners since 1974?
How many subs are allowed in a World Cup match (regulation)?
questions.explanation: Five substitutions per team since the 2022 cycle.

questions.q: Which manager has won the most World Cups as a coach?
questions.explanation: Pozzo won the World Cup twice with Italy (1934, 1938).
